approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
cadence: one reference post, then reused as a citation layer in every claim
first_installment_sketch: The precision glossary itself, applied once: take an existing loose claim from PING material ('replay produced identical decision state across runs') and relabel it to the exact layer it lives on (decision determinism, with external side effects excluded). No invented measurements; the glossary is the deliverable.
inputs: the six determinism layers from the directive
every casual determinism claim in existing material to be relabeled
name: DETERMINISM PRECISION
outputs: one reference post defining the layers
a relabeling pass over existing claims
purpose: Never casually claim 'PING is deterministic'; name the layer, because precise language builds trust.
template: Define the six layers with their exact contracts: SEMANTIC DETERMINISM (same semantic inputs -> same semantic result); BYTE DETERMINISM (same canonical state -> same canonical bytes); DECISION DETERMINISM (same authoritative inputs/policy -> same authorization decision); PROJECTION DETERMINISM (same graph + intent + context -> same projection model); VISUAL DETERMINISM (much weaker because browser/fonts/devices exist); EXECUTION DETERMINISM (usually impossible when external systems participate). Every later claim must name its layer. A claim that cannot name one stays UNKNOWN.
